sanskrit: imāṃ mātrāṃ nir vapa odanasya tasya paktā mucyatāṃ kilbiṣebhyaḥ | abhidrohād enaso duṣkṛtāc ca punātu mā pavanaiḥ pavitraḥ ||
english: Measure out this portion of the purificatory rice-oblation; may its preparer be released from transgressions. From malice, from sin, from evil deed — may the pure one, with its purifying streams, purify me.

sanskrit: bhadrau hastau bhadrā jihvā bhadraṃ bhavatu me vacaḥ | mahyaṃ pavitram odanaṃ brahmaṇā nir vapāmasi hastābhyāṃ nir vapāmasi ||
english: Auspicious be my hands, auspicious my tongue, auspicious let my speech become. For me this purifying rice-oblation we portion out with sacred formula, with both hands we portion it out.

sanskrit: yan mayi garbhe sati mātā cakāra duṣkṛtam | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever evil deed my mother committed while I was yet in the womb — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad arvācīnam ekahāyanād anṛtaṃ kiṃ codima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever falsehood we have uttered from the time of one year onward unto the present — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad duṣkṛtaṃ yac chamalaṃ yad enaś cakṛmā vayam | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever evil act, whatever defilement, whatever transgression we have committed — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yan mātaraṃ yat pitaraṃ yad vā jāmiṃ jihiṃsima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever injury we have done to mother, to father, or to a kinswoman — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yan mātṛghnā yat pitṛghnā bhrūṇaghnā yat sahāsima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever we have shared in eating with slayers of mothers, slayers of fathers, slayers of embryos — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: śyāvadatā kunakhinā stenena yat sahāsima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever we have shared in eating with one of black teeth, one of diseased nails, or a thief — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: śiśundhānāṃ pūṃścalānāṃ takṣṇāṃ yad annam āśima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever food we have eaten of dog-keepers, of loose women, of carpenters — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad apām apajahrima nimajya papimodakam | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever we have taken away from the waters, having plunged in and drunk the sweet draught — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yat kruddhā manyuto vayaṃ brāhmaṇasya nijagmima padā vā gām upārima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: That in anger, in wrath, we have struck a brahmin, or with the foot have touched a cow — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad brahmacarye yat snātacarye anṛtaṃ kiṃ codima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever falsehood we have uttered during the brahmacarya vow or during the snātaka's discipline — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: kilāsena duścarmaṇā vaṇḍena yat sahāśima ādhārābhigatena vā | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever we have eaten together with one afflicted by kilāsa-leprosy, one with diseased skin, a eunuch, or one who has approached a woman during her impure period — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yat kṣetram abhitiṣṭhātha aśvaṃ vā yaṃ niremiṣe | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever field you have wrongfully occupied, or whatever horse you have driven off — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad akṣeṣu hiraṇye goṣv aśveṣu yad dhane anṛtaṃ kiṃ codima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever falsehood we have uttered regarding dice, gold, cattle, horses, or other wealth — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: sakhyur jāyāṃ svāṃ dāsīṃ sūtikāṃ lohitāvatīm aśuddhāṃ yad upeyima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever approach we have made to a friend's wife, to one's own female slave, to a woman in childbed, to a woman in her menstrual flow, or to one who is impure — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: parivittena parivividānena abhyavasnātena paribhakṣitena didhiṣūpatyā yat sahāśima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever we have eaten together with one whose younger brother has married before him, or one who himself married out of turn, or one who has bathed after another's precedence, one who has eaten after another's precedence, or one who is the husband of a didhiṣū — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yat kusīdaṃ vibhejima dvimeyaṃ dhanakāmyā | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever usurious debt we have distributed doubly, out of greed for wealth — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad dvyekaṃ yat tryekam upaikam iti yad dadau | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever one gave as two-for-one, as three-for-one, as one added above — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yat tvaramāṇāḥ śabalam apakvaṃ māṃsam āśima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever tainted, undercooked meat we have eaten in haste — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad annam āśimā vayam anannam annakāmyā udarasyābhiśācyā | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever non-food we have eaten as food, out of desire for food, out of the belly's craving — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad vidvāṃso yad avidvāṃso anṛtaṃ kiṃ codima | ayaṃ mā tasmād odanaḥ pavitraḥ pātv aṃhasaḥ ||
english: Whatever falsehood we have uttered knowingly or unknowingly — from that may this pure rice-oblation guard me from sin.

sanskrit: yad devasya savituḥ pavitraṃ sahasradhāraṃ vitataṃ hiraṇyam | yenendram apunanamārtamartyās tenāyaṃ māṃ sarvapaśuṃ punātu ||
english: That which is the purifying filter of the god Savitṛ — the thousand-streamed, widespread golden sieve — by which the immortals and mortals purified Indra, by that let this one purify me wholly, along with all my cattle.

sanskrit: yenāpunāt savitā revatīr apo yenāpunīta varuṇaḥ savāya | yenemā viśvā bhuvanāni pūtās tenāyaṃ māṃ sarvapaśuṃ punātu ||
english: By that with which Savitṛ purified the bountiful waters, by that with which Varuṇa was purified for his sovereign function, by that with which all these worlds were made pure — by that let this one purify me wholly, along with all my cattle.

sanskrit: ati krāmāmi duritaṃ yad eno jahāmi ripraṃ parame sadhasthe | yena yanti sukṛto nāpi duṣkṛtas tam ā ruhema sukṛtām ulokam ||
english: I stride beyond whatever sin and transgression I cast off the defilement at the highest station. That path by which the righteous go but the evildoer does not — upon that let us ascend, the world of the well-doers.

sanskrit: mā yakṣmam iha hāsiṣṭa mā riphanto vi gātana | amaiva puṇyam astu no attṝn anv eti kilbiṣam ||
english: Let no disease be left behind here; depart without tearing us apart. Let the merit remain with us alone; the sin follows after those who eat it.

sanskrit: imaṃ pacāmy odanaṃ pavitraṃ pavanāya kam | sa mā muñcatu duṣkṛtād viśvasmāc cainasas pari ||
english: This purificatory rice-oblation I cook for the sake of purification. May it release me from evil deed, and from all transgression altogether.
